replacements.reason: Retain the source-owned pure GXProject value transform while excluding the remainder of GXTransform.c, which writes GameCube GX registers or contains CodeWarrior paired-single assembly and is outside the native headless runtime.
Close the compile-time exclusion after the final hardware-facing transform function so the adapted provider emits GXProject and no device or assembly implementation.

The selected pure projection function needs only GX and matrix value types. Remove private GX state and OS assertion headers whose hardware macros belong exclusively to the excluded suffix; DEBUG=0 makes the original null assertion an empty operation.

replacements.old:
void GXProject(f32 x, f32 y, f32 z, f32 mtx[3][4], f32* pm, f32* vp, f32* sx,
               f32* sy, f32* sz)
replacements.new:
void GXProject(f32 x, f32 y, f32 z, const f32 mtx[3][4], const f32* pm,
               const f32* vp, f32* sx, f32* sy, f32* sz)
replacements.reason: Match the maintained native SDK declaration's read-only qualifiers. The original body never writes the matrix, projection, or viewport inputs, and the PowerPC ABI is unchanged.
